# dx: improve installation process

Rework the bootstrap for a better first-run experience, taking cues from [Master Your New Laptop Setup: Tools, Configs (dot Files), and Secrets!](https://youtu.be/FH083GOJoIM) — a manager-driven dotfiles setup with secrets pulled from a password manager during installation. **Motivation:** "provide better developer experience."
